subject.title: fix(plugins): run message_sending on all channel agent-reply deliveries (#92374)

question: Should this PR be the canonical broad fix for the `message_sending` bypass after the suffix re-entry defect is repaired, or should maintainers split the narrower dispatcher fix from Telegram streamed-final ownership?
rationale: Multiple open PRs cover narrower slices of the same bypass, and this branch changes a shared safety-hook ownership boundary plus Telegram streaming delivery semantics.

options.title: Repair and keep this canonical
options.body: Fix suffix hook re-entry, resolve conflicts, and use this PR as the broad candidate for the configured-dispatcher plus Telegram streamed-final bypass.

options.title: Split dispatcher first
options.body: Land or sponsor a narrower dispatcher-only fix and leave Telegram streamed-final hook ownership to a focused follow-up.

options.title: Accept per-suffix semantics
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally accept per-suffix enforcement only if the PR drops the exactly-once claim and documents the long-reply behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep this canonical
recommendation.body: Fix suffix hook re-entry, resolve conflicts, and use this PR as the broad candidate for the configured-dispatcher plus Telegram streamed-final bypass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main refactor/blame touches the central files, and the decision spans the merge shape rather than one contributor's branch only.
